stories.title: India's unemployment rate falls to 5.1% in July-September quarter
stories.summary: India's unemployment rate fell to 5.1% in the July-September quarter, according to The Economic Times, with rural joblessness declining. The report does not provide prior-quarter comparisons or methodology details.
stories.why: The decline suggests easing labor-market pressure and could affect policy and economic outlook.

stories.title: New York launches registration portal for large AI developers under RAISE Act
stories.summary: New York opened a registration portal on Tuesday, requiring “large frontier” AI developers—companies with over $500 million in annual revenue such as Anthropic and OpenAI—to register by Jan 1 2027. The RAISE Act, effective at the start of the year, requires them to publish safety frameworks, report critical safety incidents within 72 hours, and issue model‑transparency reports. The new Office of Digital Innovation, Governance, Integrity, and Trust (DIGIT) will enforce the law, with penalties up to $1 million for a first violation and $3 million for later ones.
stories.why: It establishes enforceable safety and transparency standards that could shape how leading AI firms develop and deploy models.

stories.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
stories.summary: Google is notching up its chipmaking game as the company seeks to reduce its dependence on chips made by other companies for its cloud computing business. Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its tensor processing units (TPUs), in-house-developed chips meant for AI workloads, that broaden its chip portfolio to additional use cases: confidential inference and more memory capacity for large workloads.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.
stories.previousTitle: Google unveils two new TPU chips for confidential inference and expanded memory
stories.previousSummary: Google announced two new variants of its eighth‑generation Tensor Processing Units—TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max—aimed at confidential AI workloads and larger memory capacity. TPU 8tx, designed with AMD, builds security into the hardware to keep data and model weights protected and adds a custom inferencing network that enables on‑the‑fly model distillation. TPU 8i Max combines two TPU 8i chips in a single package, doubling memory, processing power and bandwidth for handling larger query data sets.

stories.title: India well on track to achieve $1 trillion exports target for FY27: Piyush Goyal
stories.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India is on track to achieve its $1 trillion goods and services export target in FY27, having already recorded nearly $480 billion in exports during April-September. Goyal urged manufacturers to expand globally, boost competitiveness and leverage international partnerships to drive exports, investment and employment.

stories.title: India may get a better trade deal: Samir Saran on renegotiating with the US
stories.summary: Following the U.S. midterm elections, Samir Saran said India should negotiate with patience, noting that aggressive U.S. tariff threats are usually part of broader talks rather than immediate policy shifts. He pointed to bipartisan support in Congress and India’s large market as factors that could help secure more favorable terms.
